title: Genetic endocrine tumors focusing on the thyroid.

snippet: Heritable thyroid tumors represent a clinically important subset of endocrine neoplasms, accounting for approximately 3-9% of well-differentiated thyroid cancers and 25% of medullary thyroid cancers.
